about: Proposals for D:\FDMS\specs/vocabulary-el-en.json from reading the WHOLE 3-01 and PD 29/2020 (glossary agent + chapter-2 pilot translation). The vocabulary is owned by FDMS: nothing here is applied to it by us.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: 3-01 §19 and §49: «να χαρακτηρισθεί ως εκτελεσθείσα (ΑΕ) / (Α.Ε.)» - here ΑΕ means a flight CARRIED OUT (the pair of ΑΔΕ), not the Training Officer.
vocabulary_conflicts.proposal: Translate those two places with term ae-ektelestheisa («Flight Carried Out»); everywhere else ΑΕ stays Training Officer.
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: No owner decision yet: FDMS side to decide.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: 3-01 Annex Β §12-13 defines Μαθητής and Εκπαιδευόμενος as DIFFERENT categories: the εκπαιδευόμενος is a qualified officer trained at ΜΕΑΕ/ΣΜΕΤ to become an instructor or to (re)qualify in type. «Εκπαιδευόμεν-» occurs ~149x in 3-01 (ΕΚΠΝΟΥ, ΕΚΠ/ΝΩΝ in tables); mapping it to «Student Pilot» merges the two populations. (PD 29/2020 Art.3 §17α uses it loosely for a referred student.)
vocabulary_conflicts.proposal: Remove «εκπαιδευόμενος» from mathitis and add a term «ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΟΜΕΝΟΣ» -> «Trainee» (el_forms εκπαιδευόμενου, εκπαιδευόμενοι, εκπαιδευομένων, Εκπνος, ΕΚΠΝΟΥ, ΕΚΠ/ΝΩΝ).
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: Owner 07/11/2026: «εκπαιδευόμενος» = Student Pilot is CORRECT. Keep the vocabulary as it is.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: In both books bare «Σμήνος» is the UNIT (a Flight): «Ανεξάρτητο Σμήνος/ Μοίρα», «Διοικητή Σμήνους». Mapping it to «Flight Commander» mistranslates every unit mention.
vocabulary_conflicts.proposal: Remove «Σμήνος» from smhnarxos_flight; render the unit «Flight» («Ανεξάρτητο Σμήνος» -> Independent Flight).
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: No owner decision yet: FDMS side to decide.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: Bare «Διοικητής»/«Δκτής» in PD 29/2020 and 3-01 is often the commander of the ΣΙ, Σμηναρχία, Πτέρυγα or Μονάδα («Ο Διοικητής της ΣΙ / Σμηναρχίας/ Πτέρυγας διακόπτει τις πτήσεις», «Δκτής, Υδκτής, ΔΕΕ, ΔΠΔ της Πτέρυγας»).
vocabulary_conflicts.proposal: Use «Squadron Commander» only when the context is the squadron; otherwise «Commander» (+ «Unit Commander», «Wing Commander»). Keep the bare forms out of el_forms or add a context rule.
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: No owner decision yet: FDMS side to decide.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: en is «Leader / Wingman» with translate:false; in 3-01 Annex Β §18-22 «Αρχηγός Σχηματισμού» is only the formation leader (with Physical / Tactical leader sub-types).
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: No owner decision yet: FDMS side to decide.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: 3-01 ch.3 §28 «[ΔΠ-1(1), ΔΟ-2(1), ΔΕ-2(1), ΕΑ-3(2)]» and «ΔΠ-1 (ΕΠ-1)» are sortie/exercise codes, not Progress Checks.
vocabulary_conflicts.proposal: Codes followed by a hyphen and number are copied as written (sortie_codes rule); ΔΠ -> Progress Check only as a standalone word.
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: No owner decision yet: FDMS side to decide.

vocabulary_conflicts.problem: In both books «Πτέρυγας» is almost always the genitive of «Πτέρυγα» = the Wing (unit): «Διοικητής της ΣΙ / Σμηναρχίας/ Πτέρυγας», «Δκτής ... της Πτέρυγας Μάχης». Applying the vocabulary turns the Wing commander into a wingman.
vocabulary_conflicts.proposal: Render «Πτέρυγα / Πτέρυγας» as «Wing» (term pteryga); keep «πτέρυγας» -> wingman only in formation-position context (Νο2), or drop it from leader_wingman.
vocabulary_conflicts.owner_note: Owner 07/11/2026: «πτέρυγας» is NOT wingman. It is the Wing; Πτέρυγα Εκπαίδευσης Αέρος = Flight Training Wing (FTW, as the Syllabus writes '120 FTW'). Remove «πτέρυγας» from leader_wingman; add Πτέρυγα -> Wing and ΠΕΑ / Πτέρυγα Εκπαίδευσης Αέρος -> Flight Training Wing.

how_to_use: The vocabulary (vocabulary-el-en.json) is FDMS's and stays the single authority.
FDMS decides each OPEN conflict and each form addition, then edits vocabulary-el-en.json itself.
Terms of rag-provisional-terms.json that FDMS adopts move into the vocabulary; the rest remain provisional for RAG-techique translations.
RAG-techique translates 3-01 and PD 29/2020 only after the OPEN conflicts are decided.

owner_rulings_on_sources.ruling: 11 training periods (the figure found in most places)
2 sorties: I41-01 and I41-02 (2.6 h, as the mission table and its total)

fdms_note: 07/11/2026 — FDMS (B): οι 5 ανοιχτές συγκρουσεις αποφασιστηκαν και οι 24 μορφες περασαν στο vocabulary-el-en.json (version 2026-11-07b, 64 οροι). Το σκεπτικο, το ερεισμα καθε αποφασης και ο πινακας αντιφασεων με τη στηλη FDMS συμπληρωμενη ειναι στην § 7 του specs/ade-handover.md. Τα πεδια `owner_ruling` ΔΕΝ πειραχτηκαν: ανηκουν στον ιδιοκτητη. Οι δυο διαδρομες `about` και `provisional_terms_file` ηταν αλλοιωμενες (ανεσκαπτα \v και \r μεσα σε JSON string) και διορθωθηκαν.
